subject: Mutual Action Plan — initial activation checklist & timing options
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.inference>
To: Lena Moore <lena@brightlab.com>, Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@brightlab.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan — initial activation checklist & timing options

Hi Lena / Carlos —

Great talking yesterday — thanks for the time and for walking us through your current inference workload and decision criteria. Per our discovery, I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) with milestones, ownership suggestions, and two timing tracks. Please review and confirm the stakeholders we should lock into the MAP.

Key milestones (high level):
- Kickoff & architecture alignment (deliverable: integration runbook) — owner: BrightLab / Redwood Solutions
- PoC integration + sample dataset run (deliverable: validated pipeline) — owner: BrightLab (dev) + Redwood SE support
- Security & compliance review (deliverable: evidence packet, questionnaire) — owner: BrightLab legal + Redwood Security
- Performance tuning & cost projection (deliverable: bench report + cost estimates) — owner: Redwood Applied ML
- Pilot acceptance & staging cutover (deliverable: signed acceptance criteria) — owner: BrightLab product + Redwood AM

Two timing options (pick one):
1) Aggressive (recommended if you have dev capacity): ~6 weeks to pilot — target close: 2026-12-18
2) Stepped (lower risk): ~10 weeks to pilot — target close: 2027-01-15

Dependencies I flagged in the draft MAP: SSO test account, sample dataset (anonymized), security questionnaire access, and a short list of production traffic patterns so we can size GPU profile.

Ask: can you confirm the primary stakeholders (product, engineering, security/legal) and which timing option you prefer? If you approve, we’ll schedule a brief MAP kickoff (30 minutes) to lock owners and dates.

Attachments: BrightLab_MAP_v1.xlsx (initial draft), discovery-recording.mp4 (call recording)

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0198

---
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference runtime and MAPs for critical pilots

From: Lena Moore <lena@brightlab.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.inference>
Cc: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@brightlab.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — initial activation checklist & timing options

Diego —

Thanks for the recap and the MAP draft. Quick answers from our side:
- Stakeholders: Lena Moore (VP Product) — primary owner for acceptance/requirements; Carlos Vega (CTO) — technical owner; Legal/Security: I’ll loop in Maria Lopez (Security lead) once we finalize the timeline.
- Dependencies: We can provide an anonymized sample dataset and a dev SSO test account by the end of next week (target: 11/30). Security questionnaire will need the SOC 2 fibers — Carlos, can your team run a quick scan?
- Timing: I prefer the Aggressive track if Redwood can commit to a 3–5 business day turnaround on the security questionnaire and a focused SE pairing for the PoC. Target close goal: 2026-12-18 looks reasonable for us.

I’ve reviewed the attachment briefly; looks good. Please update the owners column to list Lena/Carlos/Maria and we’ll confirm the Legal contact next week.

—Lena
Lena Moore
VP Product | BrightLab Analytics
lena@brightlab.com | +1 (617) 555-4221

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>

Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 13:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — initial activation checklist & timing options

Thanks Lena — appreciate the quick turnaround. Couple of clarifications from Redwood operations and an updated ownership ask:

- Redwood support for security questionnaire: our Security team will assemble the initial evidence packet (SOC 2 summary, dataflow diagrams, retention policy) and aim for a 3–5 business day initial response. I’ve attached a short "security-evidence-summary.pdf" that outlines what we can deliver quickly.
- SE pairing for PoC: Sergio (cc) will be the primary SE assigned to BrightLab PoC. He’ll handle the integration sessions and be available for 1:1 dev pairing during the first two sprints.
- Ownership updates: I’ll take responsibility for coordinating Redwood deliverables and the acceptance criteria. Diego will own the commercial cadence / MAP updates with the account.

Open items we still need from BrightLab (to hit the Aggressive timeline):
1) Sample dataset (anonymized) — deliver by 2026-11-30
2) Dev SSO test account + API access key — deliver by 2026-11-30
3) Security contact (email) — deliver by 2026-11-29

If those dates look OK, we’ll put the MAP kickoff on the calendar for next week and circulate an updated owners sheet.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Ops | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.inference
